summary: A flat hourly price per size, per second while the machine exists; the $20 plan is prepaid machine time.

plans.name: $20 plan
plans.note: Usage over the plan is drawn from a separate wallet.

notes: A stopped machine's disk is kept free for 14 days; after that it is gone unless saved as a snapshot.
Many starts in one day can hit the start limit; paid starts draw from the wallet.
No free tier; the 7-day trial needs a card.
Boat says it does not bill egress.
